steps.title: Guess, check and compare

options.label: Guess how many beans aloud first. Then tap each bean to check.
Three counters are ready. Take them all away to make zero.
Which group is larger: twelve or seventeen?

steps.hint: Your guess is not scored. Tap each bean once to find the count.
steps.explanation: Use counting to check a guess; notice zero and larger numbers.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Guess, check and compare
mathWorkshop.goal: Use counting to check a guess; notice zero and larger numbers.

tasks.prompt: Guess how many beans aloud first. Then tap each bean to check.
tasks.feedback: Your guess was a prediction. Counting shows six beans; a different guess is part of learning.
tasks.hint: Your guess is not scored. Tap each bean once to find the count.

tasks.prompt: Three counters are ready. Take them all away to make zero.
tasks.feedback: Zero means none. The tray is empty because all three counters were taken away.
tasks.hint: Remove every counter. An empty tray shows zero.

tasks.prompt: Which group is larger: twelve or seventeen?
tasks.feedback: Seventeen is larger than twelve. Five more objects make the larger group.
tasks.hint: Compare the groups, or count onward from twelve to seventeen.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Maths discovery 2
steps.prompt: Match each number word to its number.
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: These words name the numbers 11, 15 and 20.
steps.shortExplanation: These words name the numbers 11, 15 and 20.

steps.title: Maths discovery 3
steps.prompt: Count back and fill each gap.
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: Counting back takes away one each time.
steps.shortExplanation: Counting back takes away one each time.

steps.title: Maths discovery 4
steps.prompt: Choose the larger number in each pair.
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: The larger number is farther along the number track.
steps.shortExplanation: The larger number is farther along the number track.

steps.title: Maths discovery 5
steps.prompt: Choose the smaller number in each pair.
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: The smaller number comes first on the number track.
steps.shortExplanation: The smaller number comes first on the number track.

steps.title: Maths discovery 6
steps.prompt: The fruit bowl is empty. How many apples are there?
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: Zero means there are no apples.
steps.shortExplanation: Zero means there are no apples.

steps.title: Maths discovery 7
steps.prompt: Make a guess aloud first. Then count the dots. How many are there?
steps.hint: Your guess does not have to match. Count each dot once.
steps.explanation: An estimate is a guess. Counting checks it: there are 12.
steps.shortExplanation: An estimate is a guess. Counting checks it: there are 12.

source.answerKeyText: Any sensible estimate; the count is 12.

steps.title: Maths discovery 8
steps.prompt: Start at 7 and count on 4. Where do you land?
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: Four forward jumps from 7 land on 11.
steps.shortExplanation: Four forward jumps from 7 land on 11.

steps.title: Maths discovery 9
steps.prompt: Start at 15 and count back 3. Where do you land?
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: Three backward jumps from 15 land on 12.
steps.shortExplanation: Three backward jumps from 15 land on 12.

steps.title: Maths discovery 10
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: Nothing is the answer. Zero names an empty group.
steps.shortExplanation: Nothing is the answer. Zero names an empty group.

steps.title: Maths discovery 11
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: 17 is the answer. 17 is farther along the number track.
steps.shortExplanation: 17 is the answer. 17 is farther along the number track.

steps.title: Maths discovery 12
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: 9 is the answer. 9 comes immediately before 10.
steps.shortExplanation: 9 is the answer. 9 comes immediately before 10.

steps.title: Maths discovery 13
steps.prompt: A clever guess of how many, before we count, is called an...
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: Estimate is the answer. We guess before counting to check.
steps.shortExplanation: Estimate is the answer. We guess before counting to check.

steps.title: Maths discovery 14
steps.hint: Find the numbers on a track. Each step changes the number by one.
steps.explanation: 10 is the answer. Count back one step from 11.
steps.shortExplanation: 10 is the answer. Count back one step from 11.

homeActivities.text: Guess how many safe large counters are in a jar, then count to check. Record the guess and count separately; guesses are not graded.
homeActivities.textAr: جرّب النشاط مع الطفل باستخدام حاجات آمنة. اسأله يتوقع الأول، وبعدها يعدّ أو يقارن، ويحكي فكّر إزاي.

parentNote.en: Drawing and personal answers are discussed with an adult and are not automatically graded. Estimate first; a guess is not a scored answer.
parentNote.ar: الرسم والإجابات الشخصية بنتناقش فيها مع شخص كبير ومش بنقيّمها تلقائيًا. التوقع الأول مش إجابة عليها درجات.
